{% blocktrans trimmed %} How to receive your payment: {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} To guarantee anonymity, Enkätfabriken, who has conducted surveys with associated payments in a variety of areas since 2010, will handle the payments. {% blocktrans trimmed %} To initiate the payment, you will be redirected to a form on the website of Enkätfabriken (by clicking on the button below), which is solely associated with this experiment. {% blocktrans trimmed %} Once the data collection has been completed, we will determine your payment (including the participation fee of 100 SEK) based on your decisions. We will then instruct Enkätfabriken to transfer your payment to your account. You can expect receiving your payment by the end of March at latest. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} The form on the website of Enkätfabriken will also provide you with the opportunity to indicate whether you would like to have general feedback in terms of motivation and results of the experiment.
